# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering fixes and GPU resilience**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 collects upstream rendering corrections and safer GPU failure handling within Skia m158. The unreleased update corrects filtered-image sampling and glyph cropping while preserving managed APIs, generated bindings and dependency versions.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh flush failure handling** — Propagates low-level draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment remains nonfatal: affected flush work is dropped, but the context remains usable. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **GPU allocation bounds and Imagination workarounds** — Checks Ganesh buffer-size arithmetic and rejects oversized MSAA attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices. On Imagination Vulkan allocation errors, affected descriptor pools are deliberately abandoned rather than destroyed unsafely; Graphite rejects null pool handles. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Ganesh sampling and destination-read bounds** — Prevents mipmaps from incorporating unwritten scratch texels during image filtering and clips destination reads to their intended region when geometry extends beyond draw bounds. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **FreeType LCD glyph bounds** — Corrects LCD16 pixel-space bounds and source/destination cropping when glyph loads return different outlines. Bitmap dimensions, outline translation and image-buffer bounds are also checked. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Graphite painter order** — Resets depth and bounds tracking after full-overwrite draws, preventing depth wrap from reordering later output. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
